metadata.title: On the degenerate Weyl problem on isometric immersions
metadata.abstract: This paper is concerned with the Weyl problem, \emph{i.e.}, the existence of isometric immersions or embeddings of two-spheres into the three-dimensional Euclidean space or general ambient three-manifolds. We establish two results on the degenerate Weyl problem, namely when the Gaussian curvature $K_g$ is only nonnegative rather than strictly positive. First, for a smooth metric $g$ on the two-sphere, if $K_g$ is strictly positive except at finitely many points where the Hessian of $K_g$ is positive definite, then $g$ admits a global $C^{2,1}$-isometric embedding into $\mathbb{R}^3$. It appears to be the first result on the degenerate Weyl problem with purely intrinsic conditions on $g$. Second, for a general simply-connected ambient three-manifold $(\mathcal{M},{\overline{g}})$, if $K_g \geq K_0 \geq {\rm sec}_{\overline{g}}$ for some constant $K_0$, $(K_g-K_0)^{-1/2} \in L^p$ with $p \geq 2$, and a certain uniform pinching condition holds for approximate nondegenerate isometric immersions, then there exists a $W^{3,p}$-isometric immersion. Alongside we also resolve the nondegenerate Weyl problem (\emph{i.e.}, when $K_g>0$) into general simply-connected ambient three-manifolds for $g$, ${\overline{g}} \in C^{2,1}$.

analysis.progressType: 退化 Weyl 问题的内蕴嵌入条件
analysis.workSummary: 对球面光滑度量，若 Gauss 曲率除有限个 Hessian 正定的零点外为正，证明存在到 R³ 的整体 C²,¹ 等距嵌入；另在一般三维背景的可积性与逼近 pinching 条件下得到 W³,p 浸入。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出一类仅依赖内蕴曲率条件的退化 Weyl 嵌入定理。
analysis.limitations: Euclidean 嵌入要求有限曲率零点处 Hessian 正定；一般背景的 W³,p 定理另要求完整背景、近似浸入像落在同一紧集及 kε/Hε 的一致正下界。
